# SwiftDrop Delivery

> Fast and reliable package delivery service across Kenya with real-time tracking, agent pickup points, and doorstep delivery.

SwiftDrop connects senders, riders, and pickup-point agents. Users can create deliveries, pay via M-Pesa, track packages with QR codes, and collect cash on delivery via the Pochi wallet.

## Pages

- [Sign in](/auth/login): Sign in or create an account to send or deliver packages.
- [Sign up](/auth/signup): Register as a sender or delivery agent.
- [Terms & Conditions](/terms): Service terms, payment, liability, and privacy.

## Optional

- [Forgot password](/auth/forgot-password): Reset your account password.
